title: The 5 Best Patio Heaters for Large Decks
h1: The 5 Best Patio Heaters for Large Decks
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for patio heaters for large decks, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at patio heaters for large decks using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: AZ Patio Heaters Tall Outdoor Patio Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 48,000 BTU propane burner, 87-inch hammered bronze standing design, 10 to 15 foot heat radius.
strengths: 48,000 BTU and a 10 to 15 foot radius cover most single-heater deck layouts on their own
The tall standing design puts heat above head height, spreading it evenly over a seating area rather than one hot spot
Wheeled base makes it realistic to reposition as the party moves around a large deck
limitations: 87 inches tall and visually bulky, not the pick for a smaller or more curated space
Needs 3 to 5 feet of clear floor space in every direction
Burns through a 20lb tank in roughly 8 to 10 hours at full output

products.name: Amazon Basics 46,000 BTU Propane Patio Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 46,000 BTU propane burner, 9 foot heat radius, water-weighted base, Wheels for repositioning.
strengths: Close to the AZ Patio Heaters' BTU output at a lower price, making it the more affordable second unit for a two-heater layout
Water-weighted base adds stability on an open deck that catches wind
limitations: Slightly smaller rated radius than the AZ Patio Heaters model
Fills with water for stability, which is extra setup and drainage before winter storage
Basic styling compared to the hammered bronze finish on premium standing heaters

products.name: Amazon Basics Stainless Steel Commercial Patio Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 46,000 BTU stainless steel construction, Includes a stand-up patio heater cover, Wheeled base.
strengths: Stainless steel construction holds up better than powder-coated finishes under frequent outdoor use
Commercial rating means it's built for the kind of regular, heavy use a large entertaining deck sees
Comes bundled with a cover, a real add-on value versus buying one separately
limitations: Stainless steel shows fingerprints and water spots more than a bronze or black finish
Similar coverage to the standard Amazon Basics model at a higher price for the steel upgrade
Bulky to store even with the included cover
features: Includes a stand-up patio heater cover

products.name: Mr. Heater MH48PH 48,000 BTU Patio Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 48,000 BTU propane burner, Rated coverage up to 215 square feet, Silver powder-coated finish.
strengths: Matches the AZ Patio Heaters' BTU output at a generally lower street price
215 square foot rated coverage is competitive with the pricier standing heaters here
Heater's broader lineup means parts and accessories are easy to find
limitations: Finish and build quality feel a step below the AZ Patio Heaters model in owner reports
No wheeled base included on all listed variants, check before buying
features: Rated coverage up to 215 square feet

products.name: EAST OAK 55,000 BTU Propane Patio Heater with Table
limitations: Uses a 20 lb tank quickly on high

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
